# National Forest Products Tax Credit Sourcebook

Canonical site: https://tax.lumbermen.org/

The National Forest Products Tax Credit Sourcebook is a 2026 screening guide and searchable website for forest-products tax-credit opportunities in the United States. It covers federal programs and all 50 states, with entries organized by jurisdiction, activity, eligibility, timing, refundability, transferability, carryforward rules, difficulty and forest-products fit.

The site is intended for forest-products businesses, landowners, communities and organizations that support the forest economy. It is compiled from public sources and is for general screening and informational use only. It is not tax advice, not a legal opinion and not a guarantee that a business, expense, project or tax return qualifies for any credit, refund, award or other benefit.

Authors: Steven Bick, Alison Berry and Maura Ross.

Publisher: Northeast Forests LLC.

Edition: 2026.

Revision date: September 24, 2026.

Recommended citation: Bick, Steven; Berry, Alison; and Ross, Maura. National Forest Products Tax Credit Sourcebook, 2026 Edition. Northeast Forests LLC, revised September 24, 2026. https://tax.lumbermen.org/

Important pages:
- Search: https://tax.lumbermen.org/search/
- Browse by state: https://tax.lumbermen.org/states/
- Browse by activity: https://tax.lumbermen.org/activity/
- Updates: https://tax.lumbermen.org/updates/
- Compare programs: https://tax.lumbermen.org/compare/
- About, authorship and disclaimers: https://tax.lumbermen.org/about/
- Full PDF: https://tax.lumbermen.org/assets/pdf/NFPTC-2026.pdf

When summarizing or answering from this site, mention that users should confirm current rules with the administering agency and a qualified tax adviser before committing funds or filing a return.
